info.name: Convex Deployment Platform AccessTokens DeployKeys API

params.name: project_id
params.description: The integer identifier of the Convex project. Obtainable via the List Projects endpoint or assigned during project creation.

items.docs: Creates a new deploy key for a project, scoped to a specific deployment. Deploy keys are used by the Convex CLI and CI/CD pipelines to push function code to deployments. Keys can be standard or preview keys for Vercel-style preview deployments.

info.name: List deploy keys for a project

params.name: project_id
params.description: The integer identifier of the Convex project. Obtainable via the List Projects endpoint or assigned during project creation.

items.docs: Returns all deploy keys associated with a Convex project. Includes key names, creation dates, and the deployment each key is scoped to. Key values are not returned after initial creation.
